entries.text: Read Primitives dataframe queries now run on the Dask platform: window, qualify, array, list, map, struct, olap, pivot, statistical and subquery queries are computed per shuffled group or from computed key sets instead of pandas-only constructs, scalar results are computed rather than returned as lazy Dask scalars, and top-N `head()` on a Dask frame reads every partition instead of only the first.
